title: Enumerate both HF organizations and pin every candidate
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
The enumerator and inventory are uncommitted working-tree files. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status.
Anonymous pagination lists public datasets only. Private datasets are not visible and are not invented.
Inventory status complete means both organization listings were exhausted and every listed candidate is recorded. It does not mean every sibling file hash is embedded.

258 datasets embed a complete sibling file list. 384 keep a partial file list with an extension count and an omission reason. The resolved revision still pins the omitted paths. The complete-file sibling limit is 24, and the compact document stays within 1048576 bytes.
22 datasets remain in the inventory with metadata access errors: 12 recorded no configs or splits, 7 did not fetch a dataset card, 2 did neither, and 1 still has viewer splits pending.
Dataset viewer sizes are recorded for 609 of 642 datasets. Missing size payloads are omitted rather than invented.
Models and spaces are outside this dataset inventory.
The inventory file is compact JSON because the pretty form exceeds 1048576 bytes.

Node may print an ExperimentalWarning when it type-strips scripts/worldwide/discover.ts. The source-inventory audit validates the inventory document and the companion needles; it does not execute discover.ts.
